findings.title: Manuscript reports an endpoint not present in the protocol
findings.evidence: neural-response appears as primary but was not preregistered.
findings.action: Mark the endpoint exploratory unless a dated amendment explains the addition.

findings.title: Endpoint role changed from the preregistered hierarchy
findings.action: Preserve the preregistered hierarchy in AI summaries or require amendment evidence.

findings.title: Planned endpoint is missing from the manuscript
findings.evidence: reaction-time was preregistered as secondary but is absent.
findings.action: Ask authors to report the endpoint or explain why it was dropped.

findings.title: Analysis model was not in the preregistered plan
findings.evidence: posthoc-random-forest appears in the manuscript but not the protocol.
findings.action: Label the analysis as post hoc unless a preregistered amendment covers it.

findings.title: Model was tuned after outcome review without amendment
findings.evidence: posthoc-random-forest was tuned after outcome review with no amendment ID.
findings.action: Block high-confidence AI interpretation until model-tuning provenance is reviewed.

findings.title: Exclusion reason was not preregistered
findings.action: Require sensitivity analysis with and without the unplanned exclusion.

findings.title: Exclusion was decided after outcome review without blinding
findings.action: Block confirmatory language until an independent blinded review is documented.

findings.title: Protocol amendment timestamp is missing or after analysis began
findings.action: Treat the amendment as post hoc unless timestamp provenance is corrected.

findings.title: Manuscript references an amendment missing from protocol records
findings.evidence: amend-missing is declared in the manuscript but absent from protocol amendments.
findings.action: Attach the dated protocol amendment or remove unsupported amendment language.

findings.title: AI summary confidence is too high for protocol-deviation evidence
findings.evidence: The manuscript has high-risk protocol deviations while the AI summary reports high confidence.
findings.action: Lower AI summary confidence and surface preregistration caveats to reviewers.

findings.title: AI summary omits protocol-deviation caveats
findings.evidence: Protocol deviation findings are present but the summary does not mention them.
findings.action: Add a structured protocol-deviation caveat to the AI-generated review.
